reasons: Two public datasets with fixed versions, licenses and content hashes are recorded.
Every real-ecosystem Skill passed an explicit-license, pinned-commit and exact-path gate.
The 16 strong-label cases are disjoint from existing development and regression sets and cover T01-T09.
The metric contract and case IDs were frozen before the first scan.
caveats: The 24 MaliciousAgentSkillsBench safe rows are weak negatives and cannot support false-positive-rate or accuracy claims.
The 16 strong-label cases are a small stratified diagnostic pilot, not a prevalence sample.
Only one case is a preliminary dynamic candidate; static policy must approve it before container execution.
No static or dynamic performance result exists yet.
acceptance_method: Local evidence record because the baseline artifact confirmation service is unavailable in this workspace.
